notes.title: 重大消息！ ！《怡红院》即将上线！ ！ ！
notes.notes:
家人们，新品《怡红院》即将上线！！12月份不见不散！！
这是一款剧情互动游戏类型游戏，唯美的人物和优质声优配音让人身临其境逛古代青楼。
故事之中有青楼六位风姿卓越，各有特色女主，在青楼大厅之中，玩家可以任意开始选择自己喜欢的女主开启一段风花雪月的故事，过程中会和女主展开亲密互动，我们精心设计了每个角色的动作和姿势，尽可能地在画面之中展现丰富生动的人物动态，延续了花妖物语一贯的唯美风格。
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1802980/_/
在和女主的互动之中，发展一段美好的情感，玩家通过女主的丰富的语言，可以亲身体验当事人的辛酸和快乐。整个游戏过程之中还会贯穿小小游戏——古代趣味博弈游戏，古色古香的场景和游戏模式，让人欲罢不能。当然游戏之中也会经历女主的刁难，有的时候这一点小麻烦，更容易激起挑战欲。

notes.title: Update announcement on February 24
notes.notes:
We are very sorry for the delay of game update due to the recent blackout of Castle's hometown.

About the difficulty of the game and the update time of the second chapter, we make the following reply:

1. In order to keep the original fun of the game and reduce the difficulty of the game, we decided to remove the function button [home] and increase the function of answering questions.

2. About the second chapter update, now the game content is in the process of production, and we hope that the players will wait patiently. At the same time, our new game will go online as soon as possible, so that the players can experience it for free.

3.Optimize the role drawing function and do not display errors.

notes.title: February 5 Update instructions
notes.notes:
Based on feedback from gamers, we made the following changes:
1. Add the function button [home], each time you can reset the four attribute values to 50, to ensure the efficiency of game clearance, unlimited times.
2. The prompt word under [Go to Support] in the game store is changed to "After the purchase is successful, the game needs to be restarted"
